items.exampleEn: We had an intimate dinner with just our closest family.
items.exampleZh: 我們只和最親近的家人吃了一頓溫馨的私人晚餐。

items.exampleEn: Outsiders often notice problems that people inside a company miss.
items.exampleZh: 外人往往能注意到公司內部人員忽略的問題。

items.exampleEn: The old cemetery on the hill is now a quiet place for walks.
items.exampleZh: 山丘上的老墓園，現在是安靜的散步地點。

items.exampleEn: The widow joined a hiking club and made many new friends.
items.exampleZh: 那位寡婦參加了登山社，交到很多新朋友。

items.exampleEn: As a loyal follower of the team, he has never missed a home game.
items.exampleZh: 身為這支球隊的忠實追隨者，他從沒錯過任何一場主場比賽。

items.exampleEn: The company opened a nursery so staff can bring their babies to work.
items.exampleZh: 公司設了一間托兒所，讓員工可以帶寶寶來上班。

items.exampleEn: Strange fish inhabit the deepest parts of the ocean.
items.exampleZh: 奇特的魚類棲息在海洋的最深處。

items.exampleEn: The villagers built the small bridge together with their own hands.
items.exampleZh: 村民們齊心協力，親手蓋了這座小橋。

items.sentenceEn: My daughter loves playing with the other children at the nursery.
items.sentenceZh: 我女兒很喜歡在托兒所和其他小朋友玩。

items.audioEn: The villagers meet in the square every Sunday to sell vegetables.
items.audioZh: 村民每週日都會在廣場聚集賣菜。
options: Go to the city to buy food

items.sentenceEn: Three generations of my family have inhabited this old house.
items.sentenceZh: 我們家三代人都住過這棟老房子。

items.sentenceEn: Our family visits the cemetery every spring to clean the family graves.
items.sentenceZh: 我們家每年春天都會去墓園掃墓。

items.stemEn: The famous chef has thousands of ____ who watch his cooking videos online.
items.stemZh: 那位知名主廚有好幾千名追蹤者在網路上看他的料理影片。

items.stemEn: Please don't ask about her private life; it's too ____ a question.
items.stemZh: 請別問她的私生活，那是太私人的問題了。

items.passageEn: Last summer, I spent a month in a small mountain village inhabited by only about two hundred people. At first, the villagers were polite, but I felt like an outsider. Things changed when an old widow, Mrs. Kao, invited me to dinner. She had lived there all her life and knew everyone's story. She showed me the old cemetery where the village's first families rest, and she told me how a tree nursery near the river had saved the village's economy. Over time, we became close friends, and she was thoughtful enough to teach me local songs. Now many followers of my photo page love my pictures of the village.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我在一個只有大約兩百人居住的小山村待了一個月。起初村民都很客氣，但我覺得自己像個外人。後來一位年長的寡婦高太太邀我去吃晚餐，情況才有了改變。她一輩子都住在那裡，知道每個人的故事。她帶我去看村裡最早幾個家族長眠的老墓園，還告訴我河邊的一座樹苗培育場如何救了村子的經濟。漸漸地，我們成了很要好的朋友，她也很貼心地教我唱當地的歌。現在，我攝影專頁上的許多追蹤者都很喜歡我拍的村子照片。

questions.questionZh: 作者一開始在村子裡有什麼感覺？
高太太說是什麼救了村子的經濟？
options: 河邊的一座樹苗培育場

items.promptZh: 這位寡婦獨自經營一家小書店。
referenceEn: The widow runs a small bookshop by herself.
This widow runs a small bookstore on her own.
rubricZh: 「獨自」可寫 by herself、on her own、alone 等；「經營」可寫 run 等

items.promptZh: 老師幫助那位新同學，讓他不再覺得自己像個外人。
referenceEn: The teacher helped the new student so that he no longer felt like an outsider.
The teacher helped the new boy stop feeling like an outsider.
rubricZh: outsider 指「外人、局外人」（例如 feel like an outsider 等）
「不再覺得」可寫，例如 no longer felt、stop feeling、didn't feel … anymore 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 helped、has helped 等）
